brief: A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.

requirements.evidence: Three full-hex bases in a row at q=0,0; q=1,0; q=2,0 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full) locked with joints

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a bin that drains
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain – all drained full-depth bins

requirements.requirement: Herb planter – suitable for herbs with soil and plants
requirements.evidence: All three bins filled with soil and planted with basil-young, mint-young, parsley-young

finish.summary: Built a linear three-cell planter with drained full-depth bins in every cell, filled with soil and planted with three herb varieties. Open faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
